Sandbox_CSP_RVRequireClaim: RV Interior: claim needed to enter a room
Sandbox_CSP_RVRequireClaim_tooltip: On: a Project RV Interior room can only be entered by players Another Vehicle Claim System lets use the vehicle (owner; faction and safehouse members when AVCS allows). Unclaimed vehicles cannot be entered. Off: unclaimed vehicles can be entered by anyone; claimed ones still only by the people the claim lets in. Admins can always enter. A change made in the admin panel takes effect at once.
